name: Customizable Bean Pole holder, to make a tepee type frame for peas and beans to climb

captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a thick, cylindrical bracket or puck designed to support climbing plants. It features three circular holes arranged symmetrically around its top surface, which pass through the body at a slight inward angle to hold support poles. The outer surface of the cylinder is smooth and flat, providing a sturdy, low-profile base.
captions.instruction: Create a parametric, circular garden bracket in OpenSCAD to support climbing plant poles. The script should allow the user to customize the number of pole holes (from 2 to 6), the inward tilt angle of the holes (from 0 to 40 degrees), the pole diameter, and the overall thickness of the bracket.
captions.factory: The script defines a main module 'printitem' that builds the bracket using a boolean difference operation. A solid base cylinder is generated with a calculated radius and a specified thickness. A for-loop then rotates and translates cylindrical negative spaces (holes) around the center axis, applying an inward tilt using the rotate() transform on the Y-axis before subtracting them from the main cylinder.
